title: Expanded CSV and PDF always carry the Sales Type column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} exists; it was invoiced today with a labor line and a part; Labor {Sales-rep-A}, Parts {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide. The Sales Type column is off on screen
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Set the date range to today and export the Expanded CSV.
  2. Open the CSV and find the rows for {Work-order-1}'s invoice.
  3. Export the Expanded PDF and find the same rows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the CSV downloads.
  • Step 2: it has a Sales Type column after Status; the Labor row reads "Labor" with blank parts cells; the Parts row reads "Parts" with blank labor, hours and Shop Supplies cells.
  • Step 3: the PDF has the Sales Type column after Status; the cells of the side a row is not credited with show a dash.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S5-R23, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 4 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R23: “The Expanded CSV and the Expanded PDF always carry the Sales Type column, after Status, whatever the screen shows. In them, the cells of the side a row is not credited with are blank in the CSV and show a dash in the PDF.”
